_about: Renown and titles, Fable style. You start a nobody: townsfolk greet you with a plain line from `untitled`. Renown is one number earned by deeds (`renown`: points per quest completed, per level gained, and for the first kill of each elite enemy type). `tiers` name how known you are, lowest first, each from `min` renown. A title is chosen in the character window (Titles tab) once your renown reaches its `renown` and every condition in `requires` holds: { skill, rank }, { slain: enemy type }, { faction, standing }, { quest } (done), { level }, { infamy } (at least that much) or { crime } (seen committing it once). NPCs then address you by it in their greeting and farewell; with chance `mock` (default `mockChance`) they say it mockingly, from the title's own `mocks` lines when it has them, else the shared `mocking` lines. {title} in a line is replaced by the title's name.

mocking: Well, if it isn't the mighty {title}.
Mind the step, {title}. Wouldn't want a legend to trip.
Off you go, {title}. Try to live up to it.
Bye, {title}. Don't let it go to your head.
Farewell, {title}. We'll tell them you were brave.

titles.name: Adventurer
titles.desc: Anyone with a sword and nowhere to be can call themselves this. Now you do.

titles.name: Dummy Slayer
titles.desc: You beat a sack of straw. Brackenford will never let you forget it.
mocks: Hey, Dummy Slayer! The straw man sends his regards.
Careful, everyone. Dummy Slayer's here.
The Dummy Slayer! I'll guard the scarecrows.

titles.name: Angler
titles.desc: You can tell a perch from a dace, and you've caught more of both than you've lost.
mocks: Smells like an Angler, right enough.
Hey, Angler! Caught anything bigger than a boot yet?

titles.name: Master Angler
titles.desc: The mere gives up its fish to you. Old Tam pretends not to mind.
mocks: Master Angler. Master of standing about in the wet, more like.

titles.name: Cook
titles.desc: Your stew has stopped making people ill. Mostly.
mocks: The Cook! Is that what that smell was?

titles.name: Lockpick
titles.desc: No chest is safe. Neither, folk mutter, is anything else.
mocks: Hide the silver, here's the Lockpick.
Lockpick. Hands where I can see them.

titles.name: Warden of the Road
titles.desc: The Road Wardens count you as one of their own, or near enough.

titles.name: Bane of Greyjaw
titles.desc: You killed the old wolf of the mere. Some are glad. Some liked him better than you.
mocks: Bane of Greyjaw. Poor old dog.

titles.name: Hero
titles.desc: You've done enough to claim it. Whether anyone believes you is another matter.
mocks: Hero! Ha. Heroes don't come to Brackenford.
Hello, Hero. Saved anyone today?
The Hero. Every village has one. Ours is you, apparently.

titles.name: Pig Thief
titles.desc: Someone saw you with one of Bram Corrick's sows. Brackenford will never let it go.
mocks: Oi, Pig Thief! Bram's counting his sows.
Lock up the bacon, it's the Pig Thief.
The Pig Thief! Smells like it, too.

titles.name: the Wanted
titles.desc: Your face is on the reeve's board. Some folk step aside for you now. Others reach for the bell rope.
mocks: Hello, Wanted. I've not seen you, mind.
The Wanted, bold as brass. Pell's watchmen are just round the corner.

titles.name: Outlaw
titles.desc: No law will have you. Thatch Corrow keeps a rope with your name on it.
mocks: Outlaw. Keep walking.
We don't want your coin, Outlaw. Or your kind.
